--[[
    Fluxo PvP Advanced Script + Bypass
    Features: Silent Aim, ESP, Spinbot (Left Alt toggle), Infinite Ammo, Speed Hack (Left Ctrl), Anti-Cheat Bypass
]]

local lplr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local worldToViewportPoint = CurrentCamera.worldToViewportPoint
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local HeadOff = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
local LegOff = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

local FOV_RADIUS = 100
local PURPLE = Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255)
local SPIN_SPEED = 1440

-- === BYPASS (anty-cheat) dla Fluxo PvP ===
local function loadFluxoBypass()
    pcall(function()
        local repStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        for _, child in pairs(repStorage:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") and child.Name == "iac-respond" then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
        repStorage.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") and child.Name == "iac-respond" then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end)

        local originalProperties = {}
        local function spoofProperty(instance, property, value)
            if not instance then return end
            if not originalProperties[instance] then
                originalProperties[instance] = {}
            end
            if not originalProperties[instance][property] then
                originalProperties[instance][property] = instance[property]
            end
            instance[property] = value
        end
        
        local function overrideCam()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                task.wait(0.1)
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            end
        end
        overrideCam()
        
        local function applySpoof()
            local char = lplr.Character
            if char then
                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    spoofProperty(humanoid, "WalkSpeed", humanoid.WalkSpeed)
                    spoofProperty(humanoid, "JumpPower", humanoid.JumpPower)
                end
            end
        end
        applySpoof()
        lplr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            applySpoof()
        end)
        
        print("[Bypass] Aktywowany dla Fluxo PvP")
    end)
end

loadFluxoBypass()

-- === SPEED HACK (lewy Ctrl) ===
local function setSpeed(speed)
    local char = lplr.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
        setSpeed(36)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
        setSpeed(16)
    end
end)

-- === SPINBOT (przycisk Left Alt - włącz/wyłącz) ===
local spinEnabled = false
local spinAngle = 0
local spinConnection = nil

local function toggleSpin()
    spinEnabled = not spinEnabled
    if spinEnabled then
        if not spinConnection then
            spinConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                if spinEnabled then
                    local char = lplr.Character
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
                        spinAngle = spinAngle + math.rad(SPIN_SPEED * dt)
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinAngle, 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        print("[Spinbot] Włączony")
    else
        if spinConnection then
            spinConnection:Disconnect()
            spinConnection = nil
        end
        print("[Spinbot] Wyłączony")
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt then
        toggleSpin()
    end
end)

-- === PURPLE AMBIENT ===
local function setPurpleAmbient()
    Lighting.Ambient = PURPLE
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = PURPLE
    Lighting.Brightness = 1.5
end
setPurpleAmbient()
game:GetService("Lighting").Changed:Connect(setPurpleAmbient)

end)

-- === INFINITE AMMO ===
local function infiniteAmmo()
    local char = lplr.Character
    if not char then return end
    for _, tool in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
            local ammoTypes = {"Ammo", "Magazine", "Bullets", "CurrentAmmo", "Clip", "MaxAmmo", "Stored", "ReserveAmmo", "Amount"}
            for _, name in ipairs(ammoTypes) do
                local prop = tool:FindFirstChild(name)
                if prop then
                    prop.Value = 999
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

infiniteAmmo()
lplr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    infiniteAmmo()
    -- Wyłącz spin przy respawnie
    if spinEnabled then
        spinEnabled = false
        if spinConnection then
            spinConnection:Disconnect()
            spinConnection = nil
        end
    end
end)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(infiniteAmmo)

-- === SILENT AIM ===
local Caster = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ZexisShared.Modules.Caster)
if getgenv().ShotHookCaster then
    pcall(function() getgenv().ShotHookCaster:Restore() end)
end

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local target = nil
    local maxDist = math.huge
    local char = lplr.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
    local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, plr in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lplr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and plr.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local head = plr.Character.Head
            local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local dist = (mouse - Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)).Magnitude
                if dist <= FOV_RADIUS and dist < maxDist then
                    maxDist = dist
                    target = plr
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local oldCast = Caster.Cast
Caster.Cast = function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        p6 = target.Character.Head.Position
    end
    return oldCast(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
end
getgenv().ShotHookCaster = { Restore = function() Caster.Cast = oldCast end }

-- === ESP ===
local function createBoxEsp(v)
    local Box = Drawing.new("Square")
    Box.Visible = false
    Box.Color = PURPLE
    Box.Thickness = 3
    Box.Transparency = 1
    Box.Filled = false

    local HealthBar = Drawing.new("Line")
    HealthBar.Visible = false
    HealthBar.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
    HealthBar.Thickness = 2

    local NameTag = Drawing.new("Text")
    NameTag.Visible = false
    NameTag.Color = PURPLE
    NameTag.Size = 9
    NameTag.Center = true
    NameTag.Outline = true
    NameTag.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

    local DistanceTag = Drawing.new("Text")
    DistanceTag.Visible = false
    DistanceTag.Color = PURPLE
    DistanceTag.Size = 9
    DistanceTag.Center = true
    DistanceTag.Outline = true
    DistanceTag.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

    local Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    Tracer.Visible = false
    Tracer.Color = PURPLE
    Tracer.Thickness = 2

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and v ~= lplr and v.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local Vector, onScreen = camera:worldToViewportPoint(v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)

            local RootPart = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local Head = v.Character.Head
            local RootPosition, RootVisibility = worldToViewportPoint(CurrentCamera, RootPart.Position)
            local HeadPosition = worldToViewportPoint(CurrentCamera, Head.Position + HeadOff)
            local LegPosition = worldToViewportPoint(CurrentCamera, RootPart.Position - LegOff)

            Box.Size = Vector2.new(1000 / RootPosition.Z, HeadPosition.Y - LegPosition.Y)
            Box.Position = Vector2.new(RootPosition.X - Box.Size.X / 2, RootPosition.Y - Box.Size.Y / 2)

            local health = v.Character.Humanoid.Health / v.Character.Humanoid.MaxHealth
            HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(Box.Position.X + Box.Size.X + 5, Box.Position.Y + Box.Size.Y * (1 - health))
            HealthBar.To = Vector2.new(Box.Position.X + Box.Size.X + 5, Box.Position.Y + Box.Size.Y)
            HealthBar.Color = Color3.new(1 - health, health, 0)

            NameTag.Position = Vector2.new(Box.Position.X + Box.Size.X / 2, Box.Position.Y - 20)
            NameTag.Text = v.Name
            NameTag.Visible = true

            DistanceTag.Position = Vector2.new(Box.Position.X + Box.Size.X / 2, Box.Position.Y + Box.Size.Y)
            DistanceTag.Text = tostring(math.floor((lplr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - RootPart.Position).Magnitude)) .. "m"
            DistanceTag.Visible = true

            local headPos = v.Character.Head.Position
            local screenPos, onScreenTracer = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(headPos)
            if onScreenTracer then
                local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
                if dist <= FOV_RADIUS then
                    local lplrHead = lplr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if lplrHead then
                        local lplrHeadViewport = camera:worldToViewportPoint(lplrHead.Position)
                        Tracer.From = Vector2.new(lplrHeadViewport.X, lplrHeadViewport.Y)
                        Tracer.To = Vector2.new(RootPosition.X, RootPosition.Y)
                        Tracer.Visible = true
                    end
                else
                    Tracer.Visible = false
                end
            else
                Tracer.Visible = false
            end

            if onScreen then
                Box.Visible = true
                HealthBar.Visible = true
                NameTag.Visible = true
                DistanceTag.Visible = true
            else
                Box.Visible = false
                HealthBar.Visible = false
                NameTag.Visible = false
                DistanceTag.Visible = false
                Tracer.Visible = false
            end
        else
            Box.Visible = false
            HealthBar.Visible = false
            NameTag.Visible = false
            DistanceTag.Visible = false
            Tracer.Visible = false
        end
    end)
end

for i, v in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
    createBoxEsp(v)
end

game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(v)
    createBoxEsp(v)
end)

		if mobileGui then mobileGui:Destroy() end	
	
		mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")	
		mobileGui.Name = "DroneMobileControls"	
		mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

		local function makeButton(text, position, size)

			return btn	
		end	
	
		-- ABOVE D-PAD (camera forward / backward) - properly spaced

		-- D-PAD
		local dpadUp    = makeButton("↑", UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0.44, 0), UDim2.new(0.13, 0, 0.08, 0))
		local dpadLeft  = makeButton("←", UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.54, 0), UDim2.new(0.13, 0, 0.08, 0))

		local crabRight = makeButton("→", UDim2.new(0.14, 0, 0.78, 0), UDim2.new(0.13, 0, 0.08, 0))

		-- Right side - Throttle
		local thrustUp   = makeButton("↑", UDim2.new(0.80, 0, 0.55, 0), UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.11, 0))
		local thrustDown = makeButton("↓", UDim2.new(0.80, 0, 0.68, 0), UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.11, 0))

	local function armDrone()	
		if isArmed then return end	
		isArmed = true	
	
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0	
		humanoid.JumpPower = 0	
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true	
		rootPart.Anchored = true	
	
		drone.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 7, 0)	
	
		originalCameraType = camera.CameraType	
		originalCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject	
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable	
	
		fanSound:Play()	
	
		if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then	
			createMobileControls()	
		end	
	
		-- Desktop keyboard	
		local function onInput(input, processed)	
			if processed then return end	
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then pitchInput = 1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then pitchInput = -1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then rollInput = -1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then rollInput = 1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then yawInput = 1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then yawInput = -1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then throttle = 1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then throttle = -0.4 end	
	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then forwardInput = 1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then forwardInput = -1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then strafeInput = -1 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then strafeInput = 1 end	
			end	
		end	
	
		local function onInputEnded(input)	
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then pitchInput = 0 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then rollInput = 0 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then yawInput = 0 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then throttle = 0 end	
	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then forwardInput = 0 end	
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then strafeInput = 0 end	
			end	
		end	
	
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInput)	
		UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded)	
	
		-- Flight loop	
		connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)	
			if not isArmed then return end	
	
			if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then	
				local mouseDelta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()	
				angularVel = angularVel + Vector3.new(	
					-mouseDelta.Y * MOUSE_SENS,	
					-mouseDelta.X * MOUSE_SENS,	
					mouseDelta.X * MOUSE_SENS * 0.15	
				)	
			end	
	
			angularVel = angularVel + Vector3.new(	
				pitchInput * TURN_RATE * dt,	
				yawInput * TURN_RATE * dt,	
				rollInput * TURN_RATE * dt	
			)	
			angularVel = angularVel * ANGULAR_DAMP	
	
			local rot = CFrame.Angles(angularVel.X, angularVel.Y, angularVel.Z)	
			drone.CFrame = drone.CFrame * rot	
	
			local totalLift = BASE_LIFT + (throttle * THROTTLE_POWER)	
			local upForce = drone.CFrame.UpVector * totalLift	
	
			local forwardForce = drone.CFrame.LookVector * (forwardInput * 45)	
			local strafeForce  = drone.CFrame.RightVector * (strafeInput * 45)	
	
			velocity = (velocity + upForce * dt + GRAVITY * dt + forwardForce * dt + strafeForce * dt) * DRAG	
	
			if velocity.Magnitude > DRONE_SPEED then	
				velocity = velocity.Unit * DRONE_SPEED	
			end	
	
			-- ===== COLLISION (bouncier) =====
			local move = velocity * dt
			local result = workspace:Raycast(drone.Position, move, rayParams)

			if result then
				local normal = result.Normal
				velocity = velocity - 2 * velocity:Dot(normal) * normal * 0.85
				move = velocity * dt
			end

			drone.CFrame = drone.CFrame + move
			camera.CFrame = drone.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15, 0.1)	
	
			local speedFactor = math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude / 40, 0.55, 1.4)	
			fanSound.PlaybackSpeed = speedFactor	
			fanSound.Volume = 0.5 + (speedFactor * 0.4)	
		end)	
	end	
	
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(armDrone)	
end;

local function getClosestTargetInFov()
	local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local bestPlayer = nil
	local bestDist   = math.huge

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr == player then continue end
		local char = plr.Character
		if not char then continue end
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not head or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end

		local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
		if not onScreen then continue end

		local screenVec = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
		local dist2d    = (screenVec - mousePos).Magnitude

		local hrp2  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local localChar2 = player.Character
		local localHrp2  = localChar2 and localChar2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local worldDist = (hrp2 and localHrp2) and (hrp2.Position - localHrp2.Position).Magnitude or math.huge

		if dist2d < aimbotFov and dist2d < bestDist and worldDist <= aimbotMaxDist then

	return bestPlayer
end

--========================================================--
-- GREEN AURA WITH FLIES========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 45)

local SMOKE_RATE = 40

local FLY_COUNT = 12

local FLY_MIN_DISTANCE = 1.5
local FLY_MAX_DISTANCE = 5

local FLY_MIN_HEIGHT = 0.5
local FLY_MAX_HEIGHT = 5

local RAGDOLL_DISTANCE = 10

-- Current Creator Store fly SFX
local FLY_SOUND_ID =
	"rbxassetid://9114875500"

--========================================================--
-- STATE
--========================================================--

local Character
local Root

local SmokeObjects = {}
local FlyObjects = {}

local ProcessedPlayers = {}

local FlySound
local FlySoundConnection
local FlyMovementConnection

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local function GetCharacter()

	Character =
		LocalPlayer.Character
		or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	Root =
		Character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not Root then

		Root =
			Character:WaitForChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart",
				10
			)

	end

	return Character, Root
end

--========================================================--
-- CLEANUP
--========================================================--

local function CleanupEffects()

	for _, object in ipairs(
		SmokeObjects
	) do

		if object
			and object.Parent
		then

			object:Destroy()

		end

	end

	table.clear(
		SmokeObjects
	)

	for _, fly in ipairs(
		FlyObjects
	) do

		if fly.Part
			and fly.Part.Parent
		then

			fly.Part:Destroy()

		end

	end

	table.clear(
		FlyObjects
	)

	if FlySoundConnection then

		FlySoundConnection:Disconnect()

		FlySoundConnection =
			nil

	end

	if FlyMovementConnection then

		FlyMovementConnection:Disconnect()

		FlyMovementConnection =
			nil

	end

	if FlySound then

		FlySound:Destroy()

		FlySound =
			nil

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- SMOKE
--========================================================--

local function MakeSmoke(
	position,
	multiplier
)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local attachment =
		Instance.new(
			"Attachment"
		)

	attachment.Position =
		position

	attachment.Parent =
		Root

	table.insert(
		SmokeObjects,
		attachment
	)

	local smoke =
		Instance.new(
			"ParticleEmitter"
		)

	smoke.Texture =
		"rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"

	smoke.Color =
		ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0,
				GREEN
			),

			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0.5,
				Color3.fromRGB(
					0,
					180,
					25
				)
			),

			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
				1,
				Color3.fromRGB(
					0,
					80,
					5
				)
			)
		})

	smoke.LightEmission =
		0.25

	smoke.Rate =
		SMOKE_RATE * multiplier

	smoke.Lifetime =
		NumberRange.new(
			2,
			3.5
		)

	smoke.Speed =
		NumberRange.new(
			0.5,
			1.8
		)

	smoke.Acceleration =
		Vector3.new(
			0,
			1.5,
			0
		)

	smoke.SpreadAngle =
		Vector2.new(
			180,
			180
		)

	smoke.Rotation =
		NumberRange.new(
			0,
			360
		)

	smoke.RotSpeed =
		NumberRange.new(
			-30,
			30
		)

	smoke.Size =
		NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0,
				1.5 * multiplier
			),

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0.4,
				4 * multiplier
			),

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0.8,
				6 * multiplier
			),

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				1,
				7 * multiplier
			)
		})

	smoke.Transparency =
		NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0,
				0.1
			),

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				0.6,
				0.4
			),

			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(
				1,
				1
			)
		})

	smoke.Parent =
		attachment

	table.insert(
		SmokeObjects,
		smoke
	)
end

local function CreateSmoke()

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	MakeSmoke(
		Vector3.new(
			0,
			-2,
			0
		),
		1
	)

	MakeSmoke(
		Vector3.new(
			0,
			0,
			0
		),
		0.8
	)

	MakeSmoke(
		Vector3.new(
			0,
			1.7,
			0
		),
		0.7
	)

	MakeSmoke(
		Vector3.new(
			1.3,
			0,
			0
		),
		0.6
	)

	MakeSmoke(
		Vector3.new(
			-1.3,
			0,
			0
		),
		0.6
	)

	local light =
		Instance.new(
			"PointLight"
		)

	light.Color =
		GREEN

	light.Brightness =
		2

	light.Range =
		12

	light.Parent =
		Root

	table.insert(
		SmokeObjects,
		light
	)
end

--========================================================--
-- FLY SOUND
--========================================================--

local function CreateFlySound()

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	if FlySound then
		FlySound:Destroy()
	end

	FlySound =
		Instance.new(
			"Sound"
		)

	FlySound.Name =
		"FlyBuzz"

	FlySound.SoundId =
		FLY_SOUND_ID

	FlySound.Volume =
		0.55

	FlySound.Looped =
		true

	FlySound.RollOffMode =
		Enum.RollOffMode.Inverse

	FlySound.RollOffMinDistance =
		3

	FlySound.RollOffMaxDistance =
		35

	FlySound.Parent =
		Root

	-- Don't wait for IsLoaded.
	-- Start immediately.

	pcall(function()

		FlySound:Play()

	end)

	FlySoundConnection =
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
			function()

				if not FlySound then
					return
				end

				if not FlySound.Parent then
					return
				end

				if not FlySound.IsPlaying then

					pcall(function()

						FlySound:Play()

					end)

				end
			end
		)
end

--========================================================--
-- RANDOM FLY
--========================================================--

local function CreateRandomFly(index)

	local part =
		Instance.new(
			"Part"
		)

	part.Name =
		"RandomFly_" .. index

	part.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	part.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			0.18,
			0.18,
			0.18
		)

	part.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			10,
			10,
			10
		)

	part.Anchored =
		true

	part.CanCollide =
		false

	part.CanTouch =
		false

	part.CanQuery =
		false

	part.CastShadow =
		false

	part.Parent =
		workspace

	local glow =
		Instance.new(
			"PointLight"
		)

	glow.Color =
		GREEN

	glow.Brightness =
		0.15

	glow.Range =
		1.5

	glow.Parent =
		part

	local random =
		Random.new(
			index * 7919
		)

	local flyData = {

		Part = part,

		Position =
			Vector3.new(
				random:NextNumber(
					-FLY_MAX_DISTANCE,
					FLY_MAX_DISTANCE
				),

				random:NextNumber(
					FLY_MIN_HEIGHT,
					FLY_MAX_HEIGHT
				),

				random:NextNumber(
					-FLY_MAX_DISTANCE,
					FLY_MAX_DISTANCE
				)
			),

		Target =
			Vector3.zero,

		Speed =
			random:NextNumber(
				2,
				5
			),

		Timer =
			random:NextNumber(
				0,
				1
			),

		Random =
			random,

	}

	table.insert(
		FlyObjects,
		flyData
	)

	return flyData
end

--========================================================--
-- CHOOSE RANDOM FLY TARGET
--========================================================--

local function ChooseNewFlyTarget(
	fly
)

	local random =
		fly.Random

	fly.Target =
		Vector3.new(

			random:NextNumber(
				-FLY_MAX_DISTANCE,
				FLY_MAX_DISTANCE
			),

			random:NextNumber(
				FLY_MIN_HEIGHT,
				FLY_MAX_HEIGHT
			),

			random:NextNumber(
				-FLY_MAX_DISTANCE,
				FLY_MAX_DISTANCE
			)

		)

	fly.Speed =
		random:NextNumber(
			1.5,
			4.5
		)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE RANDOM FLIES
--========================================================--

local function CreateFlies()

	table.clear(
		FlyObjects
	)

	for i = 1, FLY_COUNT do

		local fly =
			CreateRandomFly(i)

		ChooseNewFlyTarget(
			fly
		)

	end

	if FlyMovementConnection then

		FlyMovementConnection:Disconnect()

	end

	FlyMovementConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
			function(deltaTime)

				if not Root
					or not Root.Parent
				then
					return
				end

				for index, fly in ipairs(
					FlyObjects
				) do

					if not fly.Part
						or not fly.Part.Parent
					then
						continue
					end

					-- Randomly change target

					fly.Timer -=
						deltaTime

					if fly.Timer <= 0 then

						ChooseNewFlyTarget(
							fly
						)

						fly.Timer =
							fly.Random:NextNumber(
								0.5,
								2
							)

					end

					-- Move toward random target

					local difference =
						fly.Target
						- fly.Position

					local distance =
						difference.Magnitude

					if distance > 0.05 then

						local direction =
							difference.Unit

						local movement =
							math.min(
								distance,
								fly.Speed
								* deltaTime
							)

						fly.Position +=
							direction
							* movement

					end

					-- Add natural buzzing movement

					local time =
						os.clock()

					local wobble =
						Vector3.new(

							math.sin(
								time * 7
								+ index
							) * 0.15,

							math.sin(
								time * 11
								+ index * 2
							) * 0.12,

							math.cos(
								time * 8
								+ index
							) * 0.15

						)

					local worldPosition =
						Root.Position
						+ fly.Position
						+ wobble

					fly.Part.Position =
						worldPosition

				end
			end
		)
end

	for _, object in ipairs(

		elseif object:IsA("Decal")

	local humanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass(

	if humanoid then

			Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None

		humanoid.HealthDisplayType =

			or object:IsA("BillboardGui")
			or object:IsA("SurfaceGui")
			or object:IsA("Sound")
		then

			object:Destroy()

		end

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- PREPARE PART
--========================================================--

local function PreparePart(
	part
)

	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	part.Anchored =
		false

	part.CanCollide =
		true

	part.CanTouch =
		false

	part.CanQuery =
		false

	part.Massless =
		false

	part.LocalTransparencyModifier =
		0
end

--========================================================--
-- RAGDOLL
--========================================================--

local function Ragdoll(
	dummy
)

	local humanoid =
		dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if humanoid then

		humanoid.AutoRotate =
			false

		humanoid.PlatformStand =
			true

		humanoid.WalkSpeed =
			0

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			0

		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType =
			Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None

		humanoid.HealthDisplayType =
			Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff

		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
			Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp,
			false
		)

		pcall(function()

			humanoid:ChangeState(
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
			)

		end)
	end

	-- Create physical joints

	for _, motor in ipairs(
		dummy:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if motor:IsA("Motor6D") then

			local part0 =
				motor.Part0

			local part1 =
				motor.Part1

			if part0
				and part1
			then

				local a0 =
					Instance.new(
						"Attachment"
					)

				local a1 =
					Instance.new(
						"Attachment"
					)

				a0.CFrame =
					motor.C0

				a1.CFrame =
					motor.C1

				a0.Parent =
					part0

				a1.Parent =
					part1

				local socket =
					Instance.new(
						"BallSocketConstraint"
					)

				socket.Attachment0 =
					a0

				socket.Attachment1 =
					a1

				socket.LimitsEnabled =
					true

				socket.UpperAngle =
					70

				socket.TwistLimitsEnabled =
					true

				socket.TwistLowerAngle =
					-50

				socket.TwistUpperAngle =
					50

				socket.Parent =
					part0

				motor.Enabled =
					false

			end

		end

	end

	-- Physical parts

	for _, object in ipairs(
		dummy:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then

			PreparePart(
				object
			)

		end

	end

	if humanoid then

		pcall(function()

			humanoid:ChangeState(
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
			)

		end)

	end
end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE RAGDOLL
--========================================================--

local function CreateRagdoll(
	player
)

	if player ==
		LocalPlayer
	then
		return
	end

	if ProcessedPlayers[player] then
		return
	end

	local original =
		player.Character

	if not original then
		return
	end

	local originalRoot =
		original:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not originalRoot then
		return
	end

	-- Clone

	local oldArchivable =
		original.Archivable

	original.Archivable =
		true

	local dummy =
		original:Clone()

	original.Archivable =
		oldArchivable

	if not dummy then
		return
	end

	ProcessedPlayers[player] =
		true

	dummy.Name =
		player.Name
		.. "_LocalCollapse"

	CleanDummy(
		dummy
	)

	-- Put dummy in workspace

	dummy.Parent =
		workspace

	local dummyRoot =
		dummy:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if dummyRoot then

		dummyRoot.CFrame =
			originalRoot.CFrame

	end

	-- Hide ONLY target

	HideTarget(
		original
	)

	-- Ragdoll

	Ragdoll(
		dummy
	)

	-- Vomit from head

	CreateVomit(
		dummy
	)

	-- Sound immediately

	PlayVomitSound(
		dummy
	)
end

--========================================================--
-- DETECT PLAYERS
--========================================================--

local function CheckPlayers()

	if not Root
		or not Root.Parent
	then
		return
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(
		Players:GetPlayers()
	) do

		if player ~= LocalPlayer
			and not ProcessedPlayers[player]
		then

			local character =
				player.Character

			if character then

				local targetRoot =
					character:FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if targetRoot then

					local distance =
						(
							targetRoot.Position
							- Root.Position
						).Magnitude

					if distance
						<= RAGDOLL_DISTANCE
					then

						CreateRagdoll(
							player
						)

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
